description.narrative: (India): ..The goal of the project is to support.the GOI's Tribal TB Initiative. Using FY 2022 funds, this activity will.strengthen the ability of national and state governments to provide TB services.to tribal populations across the country, as articulated through the National.Strategic Plan of India's National TB Elimination Program (NTEP). Given the.complexity, size, and scale of the tribal health challenges in India, USAID's.Tribal TB Initiative will work within the Tribal Health Collaborative: a.multi-stakeholder initiative that is being set up with the vision of ending.preventable deaths in India's tribal communities... ..Key components of the approach will.include 1) engaging and empowering Tribal communities in eliminating TB; 2).strengthening public and private service delivery; 3) enhancing.inter-departmental and inter-sectoral cooperation; 4) facilitating TB research,.knowledge management, and data driven advocacy; and 5) promoting innovations.and tech-based solutions in Tribal TB control. ..This intervention supports the U.S. Government's Global.Tuberculosis Strategy, which aims to reach every person with TB, cure those in.need of treatment, and prevent the spread of disease and new infections. ..
